name: The Adjuration of the Midnight Princess
source:
It's midnight. How did you get into the palace? Did you sneak, or were you chosen? Just another suitor... or a rebel hoping to make a change?

Whatever the circumstances, no one has seen Princess Aurelia in weeks; ever since her crown was taken.

She used to be Queen, you know...

Perhaps she needs some cheering up.

Or... perhaps she needs to hear some harsh truths.

Can you get the best ending and hold the Princess' hand?

[From [url=https://prettyflowerdog.itch.io/the-adjuration-of-the-midnight-princess]Itch.io[/url]]
